Application Data.NAME: Crafty Creations LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Crafty Creations LLC specializes in offering a wide range of craft and hobby supplies, including art materials, scrapbooking products, knitting and sewing items, and DIY project kits. Our store hosts workshops and classes to engage the community in creative activities, while also providing a welcoming space for hobbyists to gather and share ideas. Additionally, we offer personalized customer service to assist clients in finding the right products for their crafting needs.
Application Data.GENERAL INFO QUESTIONS:
